ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Advice delivery, Report issued and later stages need Report issued date and Compliance check.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(CASE(Stage__c, "Fact find", 1, "Analysis", 2, "Report drafted", 3, "Report issued", 4, "Accepted", 5, "Completed", 6, 0) >= 4, OR(ISBLANK(Report_issued_date__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Compliance_check__c))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Report issued date and Compliance check before moving to Report issued.
